name: Discover Seasons (Matrix)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      shards:
        description: 'JSON array of shards (e.g. ["00","1a","ff"])'
        required: false
        default: '[]'
        type: string
      all_players:
        description: 'Backlog pass: Probe EVERY player'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      concurrency:
        description: 'Burst batch size'
        required: false
        default: '25'
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: 'Report only'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_number:
        description: 'Auto-incremented by self-trigger — do not set manually'
        required: false
        default: '1'
        type: string
      backfill_teams:
        description: 'Backfill pre-season teams'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

env:
  MAX_RUNS: 40

jobs:
  generate-shards:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      targets: ${{ steps.gen.outputs.targets }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout: |
            data
            scripts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: gen
        env:
          INPUT_SHARDS: ${{ inputs.shards }}
          ALL_PLAYERS: ${{ inputs.all_players }}
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
          import json, os, re
          raw = (os.environ.get('INPUT_SHARDS') or '').strip()
          toks = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in (raw[1:-1] if raw.startswith('[') else raw).split(',')]
          toks = [t.lower() for t in toks if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-fA-F]{2}', t or '')]
          progress = json.load(open('data/discover-progress.json')) if os.path.exists('data/discover-progress.json') else {}
          mode = 'all' if os.environ.get('ALL_PLAYERS') == 'true' else 'current'
          targets = []
          for shard in (toks if toks else [format(i, '02x') for i in range(256)]):
              p = progress.get(shard, {})
              if not (p.get('done') == True and p.get('mode') == mode and not toks):
                  targets.append({'shard': shard, 'cursor': p.get('cursor', 0)})
          
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as fh:
              fh.write(f'targets={json.dumps(targets)}\n')
          PYEOF

  map:
    needs: generate-shards
    if: needs.generate-shards.outputs.targets != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 20
      matrix:
        target: ${{ fromJson(needs.generate-shards.outputs.targets) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout: |
            scripts
            data
            players/${{ matrix.target.shard }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Burst-probe
        run: |
          ARGS="--shard=${{ matrix.target.shard }} --cursor=${{ matrix.target.cursor }} --out=discover-shard-${{ matrix.target.shard }}.json --concurrency=${{ inputs.concurrency }}"
          [ "${{ inputs.all_players }}" == "true" ] && ARGS="$ARGS --all-players"
          [ "${{ inputs.backfill_teams }}" == "true" ] && ARGS="$ARGS --backfill-teams"
          node scripts/discover-seasons.js $ARGS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: discover-shard-${{ matrix.target.shard }}
          path: discover-shard-${{ matrix.target.shard }}.json
          retention-days: 1

  reduce:
    needs: [generate-shards, map]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: data-write
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: discover-shard-*
          path: /tmp/discoveries/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Merge and Commit
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          node scripts/discover-seasons.js --reduce --in=/tmp/discoveries --concurrency=${{ inputs.concurrency }} | tee /tmp/reduce.log
          
          undone=$(grep -o 'UNDONE_SHARDS_JSON=.*' /tmp/reduce.log | sed 's/UNDONE_SHARDS_JSON=//')
          echo "${undone:-[]}" > undone_shards.json

          if [ "${{ inputs.dry_run }}" != "true" ]; then
            git add data/discover-progress.json data/sports-index.json players/ team-lookup/
            if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
              git commit -m "update: progress + rosters"
              git push origin main
            fi
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name:
